name: Baile

attributes.attribute: cross-referenced to the entry on Ailinn
sweet-spoken prince of Ulster and lover of Ailinn

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The encyclopedia directs readers from Baile to the entry on Ailinn. The name belongs to Baile Binnbhéarlach, the sweet-spoken prince of Ulster who was Ailinn's lover. See Ailinn.

okr.objective: Cross-reference Baile to the story of Ailinn and her lover Baile Binnbhéarlach.
key_results: The Baile entry points to the entry on Ailinn.
Baile Binnbhéarlach was a prince of Ulster.
Baile Binnbhéarlach was the lover of Ailinn.
